title: Unique Buttery Irish White Cabbage Skillet
description: A delicious and crunchy Irish dish featuring white cabbage, perfect for a brunch mood, cooked in a clay pot with halal-friendly ingredients. This recipe is easy to make and serves as a great option for a weekend meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potato, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potato is tender and the cabbage is crispy.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
